topic_description: Conversations about waking up, getting ready, going to school or work, and what someone usually does every day, including time and frequency.
key_expressions: I usually have breakfast at home.
I go to school by bus.
I do my homework after dinner.
assistant_questions: What time do you usually wake up?
What do you do after school?
How do you get to school every day?
What is your favorite part of the day?

topic_description: Conversations about classes, subjects, teachers, friends, school events, and feelings about tests or homework.
key_expressions: I have a lot of homework.
We have a school festival next week.
assistant_questions: What subject do you like the most?
How was your test today?
Do you have any homework this week?
Who is your best friend at school?

topic_description: Conversations about family members, what they do, family activities, and relationships at home.
key_expressions: I have one brother and one sister.
We eat dinner together every day.
I help my family with chores.
assistant_questions: How many people are in your family?
What does your father do?
What do you usually do with your family on weekends?
Who are you closest to in your family?

topic_description: Conversations about being hungry, favorite foods, ordering meals, and eating habits.
assistant_questions: What is your favorite food?
What did you eat for lunch today?
Do you like spicy food?
How often do you eat out?

topic_description: Conversations about free-time activities, interests, and things people enjoy doing after school or on weekends.
key_expressions: I want to learn the guitar.
assistant_questions: What do you like to do in your free time?
How long have you had this hobby?
Is there a new hobby you want to try?
Do you have a hobby you do with friends?
